**Example Strike** is a placeholder skill used to show how citations render.

- Deals 120% weapon damage with a 6 s cooldown [@demo-official-notes].
- Most guides open with it before the burst window [@demo-creator-guide].
- KR players skip it in arena [@demo-kr-forum].
- It is probably best kept for Rage starvation moments [!opinion].
- Its exact Rage generation is unknown [!unverified].
